## About
Sir Oyedot AI Creator is the creative name used by Oyedotun Opeyemi Stephen, a Nigerian educator and creator working with AI-assisted video, cinematic storytelling, historical dramatizations and digital content.

## Education
- B.Ed., Mathematics/Integrated Science Education, Obafemi Awolowo University, Ile-Ife, 2024.
- NCE, Integrated Science/Mathematics, Adeyemi College of Education, Ondo, 2017.

## Professional background
- Mathematics, Physics & Economics educator at Abake Model College, Modakeke (2021–2025).
- Physics & Mathematics educator at His Banner Premier College, Ile-Ife (2021–2025).
- Class Teacher and Subject Teacher at New Hope Group of Schools, Ifetedo (2016–2020).
- Primary school teacher at Excellent Kiddies Nursery and Primary School, Ifetedo (2013–2014).
- Registered teacher, Teachers Registration Council of Nigeria (TRCN).
- Member, Integrated Science Educators Association of Nigeria (ISEAN).

## Creator work
- Ilé Ifẹ̀: The Dawn of a Kingdom — AI-assisted historical storytelling series inspired by Yoruba heritage.
- AI-assisted wildlife documentary-style stories and animal encounters (AI visuals, not real wildlife footage).
- Cinematic AI video advertisements and educational storytelling.
